kind: Moonless Milky Way preset with recommended native HDR settings

motion.attachment: RGBA16F: unjittered UV velocity.xy, previous linear depth, MSAA coverage; R16F: current linear depth; normalize both by coverage
limits: analytic rest-mesh wind and camera motion only; no arbitrary model-matrix animation
missing-coverage bridge retains conservative camera-only fallback

bloom.model: normalized, threshold-free linear HDR camera PSF; 1.8% radiance redistribution

hdr.shoulder: same fitted SDR ACES anchor through exposed peak 1; C1 bounded highlight extension; nit scale divided by browser/Windows SDR white
hdr.limits: System-reported luminance is not a photometer measurement and scene lux is not calibrated. This is not an official ACES HDR ODT. Extended sRGB canvas is not a native 80-nit scRGB swap chain. External-image copy is not guaranteed zero-copy. PBO copies pixels through CPU. HDR enlargement is linear, not SDR FSR1.

lens.antialias: MSAA + leaf temporal + water temporal + SMAA

temporal.scope: analytic wind/camera foliage motion, MSAA coverage, independent short water radiance history
temporal.metadata: R8 age; nearest valid depth, bilinear RGB

treeShadow.packing: Three.js RGBADepthPacking; ordinary non-reversed directional shadow
limits: receives the existing caster map; does not add missing terrain casters
plane solar-refraction interface at mean sea level
three independent PCF queries, including one volume midpoint
main renderer requests up to 60 Hz in high quality, 30 Hz balanced; actual rate is frame limited

reflection.filter: linear mipmapped colour; independent non-mipmapped depth

glintAA.model: pixel normal variance plus statistical 1/120 s temporal slope variance; only direct-sun NDF

windSea.frequencyShape: JONSWAP-shaped, gamma3.3, log-k importance weighted; no fetch/growth solve

spectrum.method: 256-mode GPU Fourier synthesis: independent narrow swell + broader wind sea, mipmapped slope moments; non-FFT
spectrum.phasePrecision: CPU double precision modulo 2pi each frame
limitations: reference-depth3m analytic spectrum; no ray-traced bathymetric refraction
linear superposition, no overturning or full nonlinear wave interactions
SWE boundary swell is a separate lower-frequency resolved system

atmosphere.model: spherical single-scattering Rayleigh/Mie/ozone atmosphere; multi-thermal, entrained volume cumulus
atmosphere.cloudQuadrature: conservative max-mip weather bounds plus one-segment margin, fixed per-pixel interleaved-gradient offset
atmosphere.cloudShapeModel: legacy capped column0; Gaussian thermal1; primary3D Worley puffs and continuous liquid-water density2

current.model: prescribed moist parcel LCL plus kinematic cumulus; no atmospheric fluid/forecast solve

target.model: prescribed moist parcel LCL plus kinematic cumulus; no atmospheric fluid/forecast solve

units.windDirection: degrees clockwise from +Z; null follows update wind

limits: LCL is a surface-parcel estimate, not a sounding
Cloud coverage is independently prescribed ascent availability
No precipitation, prognostic humidity, CAPE or Navier–Stokes solve

night.coordinates: Right-handed world+X=east,+Y=up,-Z=north before rotationDegrees; atlasICRF/J2000. Positive rotationDegrees increases geographic azimuth. Ephemeris includes topocentric lunar parallax and normal refraction; atlas rays have no per-star atmospheric refraction.
limits: Sun slider is an independent artistic direction, not this timestamp ephemeris Sun.
NASA atlas colors and plotted sizes are visualization data, not absolute photometric radiance.
Lunar texture uses approximate libration and Lambert shading, not resolved terrain/Hapke transport.
8/6-point single-scattering quadrature, not a full multiple-scattering LUT
three-sample cloud self-shadow and ground shadow
bounded diffuse cloud bounce approximation
surface-parcel LCL estimate, not a measured sounding or cloud forecast
prescribed ascent and kinematic advection/entrainment; no Navier–Stokes solve
CPU density is the exact base-LOD density formula; view rays use filtered noise LOD
GPU budget must be measured on the actual renderer

lighting.units: pre-exposed relative RGB linear lighting; physical* fields exclude2^preExposureEV; not absolute lux
lighting.note: Sun/moon strengths exclude cloud shadow. Apply cloud transmission once. Output exposure=userEV+recommendedExposureEV-preExposureEV. Sky tint is a16-ray clear-sky irradiance estimate; clouds/stellar directionality are approximated.
